package telemetry

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/AtomiCloud/diene.go-otel/adapters/otelsdk"
	"github.com/AtomiCloud/diene.go-otel/lib/otel"
)

// Bootstrap constructs the process-owned telemetry runtime. Call Shutdown from
// the application lifecycle after every request producer has stopped.
func Bootstrap(ctx context.Context, config otel.Config, identity otel.AppIdentity) (*otelsdk.Runtime, error) {
	return otelsdk.New(
		ctx,
		config,
		identity,
		otelsdk.WithGlobalRegistration(true),
	)
}
